title: On the relations among algebraic models for the MinRank problem
summary: In this article, we study the relations between algebraic models for the MinRank problem, which is a well-known NP-hard problem. We establish connections between the minors modeling, the Kipnis-Shamir modeling, and the support minors modeling, providing insights into their equivalences and differences. Our results contribute to a deeper understanding of the algebraic structures underlying the MinRank problem and may inform future research on efficient algorithms for solving it.
